fusions.name: Pressing On
fusions.desc: Flings a feather into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage. Its damage rises 7% per tenth of your own blood already lost (max 35%).

fusions.name: Ridden Down
fusions.desc: Carries you up to 7 tiles onto the target with a strike that deals 12 damage, leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Easy Glide
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 10 seconds. You move 15% faster for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Unflagging Wings
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12. It also regenerates 0.5 health a second, permanently.
